findings.title: Total loss of the monitoring/alerting path has no independent dead-man's-switch receiver
evidence: infra/digitalocean/alertmanager.tmpl.yml:86-100,144-152 — Watchdog alert routed to a dedicated `watchdog` receiver (repeat_interval 5m), documented as an external heartbeat URL

infra/digitalocean/docker-compose.yml:239-307 — alertmanager service renders the template at start and pings the watchdog receiver; unset URLs fall back to a no-op loopback (docker-compose.yml:256-258)
infra/digitalocean/prometheus.yml:11-17 — Prometheus forwards firing alerts to alertmanager:9093; prometheus.rules.yml:33-40 Watchdog expr: vector(1)
.github/workflows/deploy-do.yml:739-747 — prod deploy fails closed when ALERTMANAGER_WATCHDOG_WEBHOOK_URL is empty; :746 warns (non-fatal) for dev
docs/MONITORING_AND_ALERTING.md:331,339-352 — documents that the switch is only real when the URL points off-box and gives the stop-alertmanager test; no recorded exercise exists
docs/RELEASE_GATE.md:6-8,34 — repo states there is 'no production environment yet' and lists 'alertmanager wired to a receiver and a synthetic alert delivered' as a release-gate exit criterion
findings.impact: The receiver mechanism and fail-closed guard are in place, but with ALERTMANAGER_WATCHDOG_WEBHOOK_URL unset (per this run's operator context; not repo-verifiable) the Watchdog pings the loopback no-op, so a total loss of the droplet is still silent. Because the guard is fail-closed, a prod deploy also cannot complete until the URL is set. The path has never been exercised.
findings.recommendation: Provision the external heartbeat (healthchecks.io-style) secret for the prod environment, deploy once, then perform and record the documented exercise: stop alertmanager, confirm the external service pages within its grace period, and store the artifact.
findings.note: re-verified at 8d299b8d: routing + fail-closed guard present (alertmanager.tmpl.yml:86-100,144-152; deploy-do.yml:739-747) but the external receiver URL is not provisioned per run context (watchdog URL still unset) and no exercise artifact exists — configured, not exercised. Previous 9c0b88c row claimed verified-fixed on the guard alone; corrected here. Cross-ref NOTIF-domain finding on critical-receiver delivery assurance.

findings.title: Prometheus alert-rule unit tests are not wired into CI

findings.title: Alerting secrets are not documented in the secrets matrix or environment-variable reference
evidence: docs/GITHUB_SECRETS_AND_VARIABLES_MATRIX.md:55,93 — lists SENTRY_DSN and SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL but no ALERTMANAGER_* or NTFY_ALERTS_* entries
docs/ENVIRONMENT_VARIABLES.md — no ALERTMANAGER_* or NTFY_ALERTS_* entries

## Executive Summary

MCT's incident readiness is materially better than at the 20261004 run. The platform now has a real IR plan with roles, a three-level severity model, containment phases, a communication table and a postmortem requirement (`docs/INCIDENT_RESPONSE.md`), plus a 459-line breach plan with detection sources, containment playbooks, an assessment map, a notification decision record and a breach register schema (`docs/DATA_BREACH_RESPONSE.md`). Operator runbooks cover the top failure modes (`docs/PLATFORM_FAILURE_RUNBOOKS.md`), rollback docs now agree with the workflow, the worker health check is fatal, the restore drill asserts structure, freshness and RLS, and the previously unwired metrics plus the RLS/impersonation alerts are live with promtool unit tests.

The remaining risk is concentrated in **operationalization**, not documentation:

1. **The dead-man's switch is not provisioned.** Routing and the fail-closed prod guard exist, but with `ALERTMANAGER_WATCHDOG_WEBHOOK_URL` unset the Watchdog pings a loopback no-op — a total loss of the droplet is still silent, and prod deploys are blocked by the same guard until it is set. Nothing about the path has been exercised.
2. **Nobody is on the rota.** The plan says it is not operational until names and escalation contacts are recorded; they are not.
3. **No exercise has been run and the only scenario catalog is stale.** The committed catalog (20261002) still says the IR plan is absent and Alertmanager is not deployed; its monitoring-loss scenario no longer matches the system.
4. **The plans were not refreshed after the alerting fix.** Both the IR plan and the breach plan still tell operators "Alertmanager is not deployed" and point at template files that only exist inside an old audit run folder.
5. **Two detection gaps remain:** audit-trail gaps are still log-only, and webhook dead-letters / reconciliation drift have counters but no alert rules. Alert-rule unit tests are not run in CI.

Recommended next actions: provision the watchdog heartbeat and record the documented stop-Alertmanager exercise; fill the rota; promote a refreshed scenario catalog into `docs/` and run Scenario 11 (monitoring-path loss) as the first recorded tabletop; refresh the two plans' alerting sections and template links; add the audit-gap and dead-letter rules.
